name: decision_conflict
description: POST-MVP (DR-009). A decision is recorded for Option A, then the room drifts into discussing Option B as though it had been selected. Kept to prove the architecture generalises; no detector is built.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Alright, we're going with option A, the managed service.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: So for option B, do we need the extra node pool or not?

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Two should be enough for B.
